item.title: Messing with an ESP32-C3 Super Mini
item.description: A HackerBox dropped an ESP32-C3 Super Mini on my desk — a thumb-sized board with WiFi, Bluetooth, and a USB-C port, all for a couple of bucks. This is the whole path from sealed bag to “it’s printing every WiFi network in my house,” including the ten minutes Ubuntu 24.04 spent flat-out refusing to open the Arduino IDE. If you’ve got the same board and the same OS, you can follow along and skip the head-scratching.
